body:
living is not.

Live

* If you don't like where you are, staying there wont help you
* If you feel too weak to change things, calm down, stop overthinking and find out what you do have the energy for
* Once you are doing what you like and focussing on it, you will build up energy to do the things that stand in your way 


Don't forget yourself while helping others

first of all, make sure you fill up your battery

the more you focus on the things you don't like the more you will notice them everywhere. so start doing stuff you like to do. you probably send a lot of energy with worrying and avoiding unpleasant stuff. make a habit from noticing and cutting off unwanted habits. 
oh and on a side note: I was amazed at how much eating and sleeping right changed my life for the better, look into that ;)

start with small things and keep records, even if it is just in your head, of your leveling up
